cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Aperiodic terrain, grass, gravel, concrete, and asphalt materials in UE5, Unity HDRP, Substance, and Three.js
Eliminating both periodic wallpaper grid repetition AND the −42.26% contrast washout blobs of linear hex/triangle blending
Normalizing mean-centered barycentric blends by √(w₁² + w₂² + w₃²) in 4 ALU instructions per pixel
Pairing with Geiss Triplanar Projection (Round 91) and Analytic Ray Footprints textureGrad (Round 61)
not_for: Regular man-made architectural tiles (chessboards, bathroom ceramic grids, brick walls) where strict periodic grid alignment is desired
Single-tap non-blended nearest-cell Voronoi lookup (which preserves variance but creates hard C⁻¹ seam cuts)
Neural diffusion texture generation or outpainting

dark_box.lead: MIT original code. Synthetic educational scene; local checks reproduced. No production, physics, or neural inference certification.
